work_identified: Gold- und Rosenkreutzer. Correspondenz und Aufnahme — archival manuscript compilation by Georg Christoph von Röpert (1743–1819), a Mecklenburg estate-owner and Gold- und Rosenkreuz circle-director; the compilation gathers actual order correspondence (letters between members) and reception/admission procedure documents, preserved in the Sammlung Kloß (now The Hague). No stable single-work identity.
